bill.title: An Act amending the act of March 10, 1949 (P.L.30, No.14), known as the Public School Code of 1949, in school safety and security, providing for prohibition of artificial intelligence for school-based mental health and counseling.

posted_text:
🧠 Healthcare
PA SB 1505 — PA Schools Ban AI Therapists

Pennsylvania is stepping up to block artificial intelligence from being used for mental health support in schools. Starting now, schools can’t use AI chatbots or other generative AI systems – like those that create fake images – to diagnose students’ mental health, provide therapy, or even recommend treatment plans. This includes systems that try to mimic the work of school counselors, psychologists, or social workers. ...
